**Finding submitted: deviation (critical) — Section 20 / p0080**

Section 20 contained only a broad one-way Customer indemnity ("every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services") with no Vendor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement — walk-away territory under INDEMN. Section 9.3's reference to remedies "required by Section 20.5" confirmed the missing Vendor infringement provisions.

Redline (validated ok:true, preferred position):
- **20.1** rewritten as Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data exposure, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, extending to Customer Affiliates.
- **20.2** usual exclusions (Customer modifications, combinations, Customer specifications).
- **20.3** our indemnity narrowed to Customer-provided content and our breach of Applicable Law.
- **20.4** notice, control, cooperation, no adverse settlement without consent.
- **20.5** procure / modify / replace, else terminate and refund — filling the existing Section 9.3 cross-reference.

The Section 21.1 one-month cap is left to the liability rule; Section 21.3 already carves indemnification obligations out as Excluded Claims.
